scope: Five randomly selected Book 7 chapters read end to end: 23, 32, 36, 48, 83. Observations do not imply exhaustive coverage.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Titivated
events.summary: Carl receives Titivated, reducing projectile damage. The reduction is not quantified.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Enchanted earplugs
events.summary: Carl puts in enchanted earplugs for the bombardment. Their protection is not quantified.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Invisibility potion used
events.summary: Carl drinks an invisibility potion; this does not establish a learned spell.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Invisibility potion used
events.summary: Donut drinks an invisibility potion; this does not establish a learned spell.

events.subject: Mongo
events.name: Invisibility potion applied
events.summary: Carl applies an invisibility potion to Mongo.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Tiara of a Thousand Lights
events.summary: Donut uses Targeting, newly added to her crown. Its rank is unstated.

events.subject: Justice Light
events.name: Character level
events.summary: Justice Light is confirmed at level 65.

events.subject: Prepotente
events.name: Recruited as Colonel
events.summary: Carl recruits Prepotente and assigns him the rank of Colonel.

events.subject: Prepotente
events.name: Enhanced Pet Biscuit
events.summary: Prepotente reports possessing several enhanced pet biscuits. Their exact count is unstated.

events.subject: Louis Santiago
events.name: Donut Holes shirt
events.summary: Louis is wearing a magical Donut Holes shirt. No stat bonus is stated.

events.subject: Samantha
events.name: Nuclear bomb
events.summary: Samantha reports possessing a nuclear bomb stolen from Buster. Her plan to use it has not occurred.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Nuclear bomb attached to robot dog
events.summary: Carl confirms possessing a nuclear bomb still attached to a robot dog.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Princess Lunette flesh-golem body
events.summary: Samantha identifies the flesh-golem body in Carl’s inventory as a possible donor; no transplant has occurred.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Mordecai’s Special Brew
events.summary: Donut confirms that she still carries a Mordecai’s Special Brew. It has not been consumed in this observation.
